Distinguished observation, hypothesis, law and theory through examples and comparison.

Applied the distinction to salt water boiling and described thermometer evidence.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the differences between observations, hypotheses, laws and theories using everyday experiments and evidence. Tara correctly explained that a law describes what happens and a theory explains why, and applied this to salt water boiling. There was a brief mix-up between a prediction and what would support a hypothesis; this was clarified later when Tara stated the expected comparison and evidence method. At home, ask Tara to sort a few everyday science statements into law, theory, hypothesis or observation and explain the reason for each.
